claims.content: C2 JU terminates and purges surveillance tracks by ceasing reporting and transmitting J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report messages for tracks it no longer reports, and by automatically purging remote tracks that are no longer being updated.

goal.raw_text: C2 JU terminates and purges surveillance tracks by ceasing reporting and transmitting J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report messages for tracks it no longer reports, and by automatically purging remote tracks that are no longer being updated.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU is currently reporting a track for which it currently has R2.
The C2 JU is not ceasing reporting the track because it has relinquished R2 to another JU.
The C2 JU is not ceasing reporting the track because the track has become an Active IU on the network with the same TN.
The system does not receive a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, and receives no further updates on the remote track.
The C2 JU ceases reporting a track for which it currently has R2, or the system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message and receives no further updates on a remote track.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU ceases reporting a track for which it currently has R2, or the system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message and receives no further updates on a remote track.

claims.content: The C2 JU ceases reporting a track for which it currently has R2.
The C2 JU transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message on the surveillance TN.

When the system does not receive a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, and receives no further updates on the remote ballistic missile track, the system automatically purges the remote ballistic missile track after a specific time interval; the time interval is a system-selected parameter.
For air, surface (maritime), and land (ground) tracks, if a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R2 to another JU, the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is not transmitted.
For air, surface (maritime), and land (ground) tracks, if that track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN, the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is not transmitted.
For subsurface tracks, if that track becomes an active IU on the network with the same address as was previously being used as the reference TN, the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is not transmitted.
For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall be transmitted at time of deactivation.

For ballistic missile tracks, the J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, is not transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a ballistic missile track because it has relinquished R2 to another JU.

If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
For EW product information, when the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met, the transmission of EW product information shall be terminated.
For EW product information, the information may be purged in accordance with system design.
When a JU drops or ceases reporting EW information, that it has been reporting on the interface, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
For EW product information, the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted on remote reports.
For EW product information, remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria.

If the system does not receive a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, and receives no further updates on the remote ballistic missile track, the system automatically purges those tracks after a specific time interval; the time interval is a system-selected parameter, thereby purging the remote ballistic missile track.

If nonC2 JUs hold locally held remote tracks that are no longer being updated, they may automatically purge the locally held remote tracks after a specified time interval; the time interval is a system selected parameter, thereby purging the locally held remote tracks.
For EW product information, remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria, thereby purging the remote reports.
The C2 JU has ceased reporting the track, and a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message has been transmitted on the surveillance TN.
For air, surface (maritime), and land (ground) tracks, the J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message is not transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R2 to another JU.
For air, surface (maritime), and land (ground) tracks, the J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message is not transmitted when that track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN.

For subsurface tracks, the J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message is not transmitted when that track becomes an active IU on the network with the same address as was previously being used as the reference TN.
For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message is transmitted at time of deactivation.

For ballistic missile tracks, the J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, is not transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a ballistic missile track because it has relinquished R2 to another JU.

If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message is transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.

When the system does not receive a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, and receives no further updates on the remote ballistic missile track, the system automatically purges the remote ballistic missile track after a specific time interval; the time interval is a system-selected parameter.

NonC2 JUs may have the capability to automatically purge locally held remote tracks after a specified time interval when these tracks are no longer being updated; the time interval is a system selected parameter.

For EW product information, the transmission of EW product information is terminated when the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met; the information may be purged in accordance with system design.
When a JU drops or ceases reporting EW information that it has been reporting on the interface, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted.
The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is not transmitted on EW remote reports.
EW remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria.
